description: Test Data of Proof-of-Concept Vehicle Platooning Based on Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office. (2016). Test Data of Proof-of-Concept Vehicle Platooning Based on Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC). [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504510". The data represent the performance of a proof-of-concept vehicle platooning based on the Cooperative Adaptive Cruise Control (CACC) application. The Federal Highway Administration’s Turner Fairbank Highway Research Center (TFHRC), in conjunction with the Volpe National Transportation Systems Center, tested and evaluated this prototype system in 2016. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 478 columns, among them max_accel_CACC-gry, green_prism_rssi-gry, silver_admas_sos-gry, white_prism_sos-gry, black_prism_too-gry, desTGapPVeh_CACC-gry. The portal shows 2018-06-13 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation’s (USDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recom. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
